name: Seat map
description: A rail carriage drawn from above, with seat pairs, an aisle, doors, racks and windows, for choosing seats across several cars.

props.name: cars
props.type: { id: string; rows: number; layout?: string; taken?: string[]; price?: number; name?: string }[]
props.description: The train, front car last. layout lists seat letters with a space for each aisle, e.g. "AB CD" (the default) or "A BC"; taken lists seats such as "11A" that cannot be chosen. The first and last cars are drawn with a cab.

props.name: value
props.description: Chosen seats (controlled), each as car id, a dash and the seat, e.g. "3-11A". Use defaultValue when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when a seat is chosen or removed.

props.name: max
props.description: Most seats that can be chosen at once.

props.name: car
props.description: The car shown (controlled). Use defaultCar when uncontrolled; it starts on the first car.

props.name: onCarChange
props.description: Called when another car is shown, from the train diagram, the arrows, or Page Up and Page Down.

props.name: towards
props.description: Where the train is heading, shown above the carriage with the direction of travel.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible heading, which also names the seat grid.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Below 800 pixels wide the carriage turns upright.
